rationale.campaign_length: R77有33项直接任务定义，另有条件性前身衔接。
rationale.complexity: 形成条件、前身分支和多地区战线需规划。
rationale.dark_story: 等级化族群与劳役构成明确阴暗制度。
rationale.difficulty: 形成与军事整合要求较高，未实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 前身路线有所差异，R77主线更偏强制秩序。
rationale.early_pressure: 前身须先在半岛竞争并达成形成门槛。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 旧王国与种姓军政为主，魔奇不是核心。
rationale.narrative_density: 古帝国记忆、三种前身衔接和秩序重塑形成长线故事。
rationale.tall_play: 故土建设存在，但主循环是更广的征服。
rationale.trade_economy: 香料与故土经济有内容，但不是最强辨识点。
rationale.warfare: 形成与后续霸权任务高度依赖领地战争。

identity.appearance: 符合条件的原初虎人国家形成，非1444起始国
identity.formation_scope: R43都阇揭、R45乌摩达阇、R50罗婆稽苦罗有脚本衔接任务，但不是唯一可形成前身；需原初虎人文化、规定领土、宗教及军队传统

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 没有什么比一只愤怒的老虎寻求与你血战更可怕的了。虎人非常了解这一点，尽管许多虎人仍然这样行事，但大多数虎人已经变得颓废和酸腐。而繁罗曷会把最年轻最具攻击性的虎人置于前线，让其迅速地以年轻人无羁的凶猛向敌人发起冲击。在毁灭性的冲锋后，接下来是经验丰富的老兵的稳步前进和冲锋，向敌人进行加倍的毁灭性冲锋，不给敌人留下任何时间恢复。
description.text_en: Few things are as scary as an angry tiger out for your blood. The harimari know that well enough, and while many still use that, the majority has grown decadent and philosophical. In Vanrahar they put the youngest most aggressive males in the front line, when it's their turn they will quickly charge their enemies with the unbound ferocity of youth. This devastating charge is then followed up by the steady march and charge of more experienced veterans, to double down on the devastating charge and to leave no time to recover.

description.text: 尽管虎人从他们的原始根源飞升到现在已经有很多个世纪了，但战斗中还是易于显露他们的野性。他们是天生持器的凶猛战士，即使是徒手的虎人也仍然是个威胁。所有的虎人都依赖于这种凶猛，在繁罗曷，这种凶猛力量甚至翻了个倍。这些来自古代家园的战士被认为是全东洲最强大的之一。
description.text_en: While it has been many centuries since the harimari ascended from their primal roots, their savagery arises easily during combat. They are fierce warriors with weapons, but even a disarmed harimari is a threat. All harimari have relied on this ferocity, however in Vanrahar they doubled down on this strength. The warriors from the ancient homelands are seen as some of the strongest in all of Haless.

description.text: 自从诃利秣带领虎人走出丛林（现在是繁罗曷的中心地带），征服整个罗祆和东洲以来，已经有1500年了。他的政策和其他改革有很多值得说道的，但他成功的核心在于他的军事天赋。作为回应，繁罗曷的虎人加倍了他们的军事教育，希望以此诞生一个新的诃利秣。
description.text_en: It has been 1500 years since Harimar led the harimari from the jungles that now make up the heartland of Vanrahar and out to conquer all of Rahen and Haless. Many things can be said about his policies and other reforms, but at the core of his success lies his military genius. In response the harimari from Vanrahar doubled down on their military education in the hopes of creating a new Harimar.

description.text: 虽然在大多数虎人国家，战士种姓的地位低于哲学家和官员种姓，但在繁罗曷，战士种姓的重要度已经高过他们更有智力天赋的兄弟。
description.text_en: While in most harimari nations the warrior caste has a role below the philosopher and administrative caste, in Vanrahar the importance of the warrior caste has been raised above their more intellectually inclined brothers.

description.text: 《一万黑豹》是一首史诗的名字，讲述的是一支神话中在诃利秣的指挥下久经沙场的精锐部队。他们经历了许多困难和损失，但最后总是取得了胜利。最后，这支部队在艰苦卓绝的最后一战中被消灭了，因为他们面对的是比他们多二十倍的敌军。据说他们还是击溃了敌人，尽管自己已经被彻底摧毁。诃利秣认为这是这场胜利是悲剧性的，尽管如此，这场仗还是赢了。他们英勇事迹的传说激励了许多来自繁罗曷的年轻虎人去追求军事生涯。
description.text_en: 'The Ten Thousand Panthers' is the name of an epic poem about a mythical unit of elite forces that fought many battles under the command of Harimar. They underwent many hardships and losses but always came out on top at the end. Finally the unit was wiped out in a heroic last stand as they stood their ground against an army twenty times their number. Supposedly they broke their enemies despite having been completely destroyed and Harimar considered it a tragic victory, but a victory nonetheless. The tales of their exploits inspire a great number young harimari from Vanrahar to pursue a military career.

description.text: 当其他的虎人对他们的人类臣民采取宽容的政策时，繁罗曷虎人认为人类种姓在任何层面上都更低级，他们的存在纯粹是为了养活国家经济和战争机器。繁罗曷的工头也毫不掩饰地镇压任何动乱，当然，他们不会顾虑使用武力。
description.text_en: While other harimari adopted a tolerant policy towards their human subjects, in Vanrahar they considered the human castes lower in every sense of the word. They existed purely to feed the economy and war machine of the nation. The taskmasters of Vanrahar were then also not shy in cracking down on any unrest. And they were certainly not afraid to use force.

description.text: 随着世界其他地方采用火器技术和改进的火枪，繁罗曷的虎人意识到他们必须适应。然而由于反感彻底采用其他文明的火枪，他们反而发展了减少大炮和火枪射击造成的伤亡的技术。在集合起来向敌军快速冲锋之前，他们会先以更分散的阵形靠近敌人的战线。
description.text_en: With the adoption of firearm techniques and improved muskets by the rest of the world, the harimari of Vanrahar realised they had to adapt. Though loathe to properly adopt the muskets of other cultures, they instead developed techniques to reduce casualties to both cannon and musket fire. They approached the enemy lines in more spread out formations before converging on the enemy in a rapid charge.

description.text:
「老虎！老虎！黑夜的森林中，燃烧着的煌煌的火光，是怎样的神手或天眼，造出了你这样的威武堂堂？

你炯炯的两眼中的火，燃烧在多远的天空或深渊？他乘着怎样的翅膀搏击？用怎样的手夺来火焰？

又是怎样的膂力，怎样的技巧，把你的心脏的筋肉捏成？当你的心脏开始搏动时，使用怎样猛的手腕和脚胫？」
description.text_en:
'Tyger Tyger, burning bright, In the forests of the night; What immortal hand or eye, Could frame thy fearful symmetry?

In what distant deeps or skies Burnt the fire of thine eyes? On what wings dare he aspire? What the hand, dare seize the fire?

And what shoulder, & what art, Could twist the sinews of thy heart? And when thy heart began to beat, What dread hand? & what dread feet?'

description.text:
当我们的人民第一次被赋予更高的智力，并以爪子抓取他们的智慧时，丛林法则是我们的法律，而力量是我们宣称统治地位的权利。我们中最伟大的诃利秣以武术精神赢得了对东洲的统治权，当我们的许多表亲在整个东方的金色宫殿中陷入懒散的颓废时，我们都阇揭人并没有忘记牙和爪的统治。

在这里，我们民族的尚武精神丝毫未减，凭借强大的实力，我们将再次进行统治。
description.text_en:
When our people were first endowed with higher intellect and clawed their way into sapience, the rule of the jungle was our law, and strength was the right by which we asserted dominance. With martial spirit did Harimar, Greatest of Us, win supremacy over the men of Haless, and while many of our cousins have fallen into lazy decadence in golden palaces throughout the east, we in Tujgal have not forgotten the rule of Tooth and Claw.

Here, the martial spirit of our folk is undiminished, and by right of might we will once more rule.

description.text:
一系列的试验和战争游戏，旨在将年轻人训练成下一代优秀的将军和军官，终局游戏是一系列的考试，每个虎人年轻人在他们的第14年都会接触到。终局游戏不仅测试身体技能和战术敏锐度，而且测试情感持久性和自我牺牲的意愿，是一项艰巨的挑战，因其对青年造成的极端精神创伤和身体伤害而受到批评。

尽管如此，不可否认的是，一起通过终局游戏的队伍被编织成牢不可破的友情纽带，这将向都阇揭的全体居民灌输战争知识和进行这些战争的方法。
description.text_en:
A series of trials and war games intended to train the youth into the next generation of excellent generals and officers, the Ending Games were a series of exams that every harimari youth was exposed to in their 14th year. Testing not only physical skill and tactical acumen but emotional durability and willingness to self-sacrifice, the Ending Games were a grueling challenge that were criticized for the extreme mental trauma and physical damage it exposed the youth to.

Despite this struggle, there was no denying that the cohorts that passed through the Ending Games together were knit together into unbreakable bonds of camaraderie that would instill the whole of the population of Tujgal with both knowledge of war and the means of prosecuting those wars.

description.text:
波苦罗繁的红树林影子长，水温高，适合狩猎——许多诗人都认为这是整个飞升半岛最好的一块土地。虽然它被都阇揭统治了很多年，但在1380年代，罗婆稽苦罗的诡计多端的领主与腐朽的罗阇合谋，以保护海岸不受部缚乌离奴隶的侵略为幌子，入侵了这块土地并夺取了其中一部分。虽然我们提出了抗议，但我们的声音被忽视了，我们的土地被以「维持和平」的名义占领。

自从这次背叛以来，我们一直怀恨在心，尽管我们的人数与黑虎的人数有很大的差距，但收复波苦罗繁始终是波罗部的首要军事目标。但我们的等待得到了回报，因为在1504年，部缚乌离的奴隶领主向我们提出了粉碎罗婆稽苦罗的计划，而罗阇的军队则卷入了第二次维齐尔之战。我们一起发动了联合入侵，我们的军队占领了波苦罗繁，而部缚乌离人则占领了岬角城并港烧毁了罗婆稽苦罗的舰队。罗婆稽苦罗的懦弱的西那波底看到我们不可阻挡的前进步伐，便逃之夭夭，自此，我们独自屹立在虎人之乡的统治阶层之首。我们迅速行动起来，从控制着半岛上一千多块小土地的尤伽波罗部那里获得了忠诚的誓言，标志着都阇揭对南部的霸权开始。
description.text_en:
The Mangrove forest of Pahruavan, where the shadows are long, the waters warm, and the hunting good - many poets have opined it the finest piece of land in all of the Ascension Peninsula. Though it was ruled by Tujgal for many years, the scheming lords of Rabaghekhur conspired with the decadent Rajas to seize the land in the 1380s under the guise of protecting the coast from invasion by Bhuvauri, and piratical incursions. Though we protested, our voices were ignored and our lands occupied 'to keep the peace'.

Since this betrayal, we have nursed our grudge, and the reclamation of Pahruavan has always been the foremost military goal of the prabhi of Tujgal. We were rewarded for our patience when, in 1502, the slave lords of Bhuvauri approached us with a plan to crush Rabaghekhur while the armies of the Raj's were embroiled in the 2nd War of the Vizierate. Together we launched a joint invasion, with our armies seizing Pahruavan while the Bhuvauri retook Sardika, burning Rabaghekhur’s fleet in the process port. The cowardly Senapti of Rabaghekhur, seeing our unstoppable advance, fled, and we stood alone atop the hierarchy of the Harimari homeland. Moving quickly, we elicited oaths of loyalty from the Oghaprabhi who controlled the thousand small holdings of the peninsula, marking the beginning of Tujgali hegemony in the south.

description.text:
一千多年来，飞升半岛的管理一直是通过尤伽波罗部系统进行的，在这个系统中，各个虎人领主代替罗阇国控制着个人狩猎区。虽然在保持半岛和平方面很有效，但事实证明该系统在集中管理王国方面是远远不够的。

取而代之的是一种基于像贾达尔军团统治的那些王国一样的布勒瓦尔领地总督制的新的控制模式，地方统治者经常被轮换到各个领地，以至于他们无法在半岛的各个角落建立地方权力基地。这种制度打破了当地地主的束缚，尽管许多小贵族叛乱使该制度的最初实施充满坎坷，但从长远来看，这种制度的效率证明了其价值。
description.text_en:
For over a thousand years, the governance of the Ascension Peninsula has been managed through the Oghaprabhi system, wherein individual harimari lords have controlled personal hunting territories in the Raj's stead. While effective at keeping the peninsula peaceful, the system proved woefully inadequate for centrally managing the realm.

It was replaced instead with a new model of control based on the governorships of Bulwari realms such as those ruled by the Jaddari, wherein local rulers were rotated to various realms often enough that they could not establish local powerbases in individual corners of the Peninsula. This system broke the back of the local landlords, and though many minor noble revolts made the initial implementation of the system rocky, the efficiency of such a system proved its worth in the long term.

description.text:
当罗祆中心在贾德帝国入侵后陷入混乱时，都阇揭在南部的丛林中顽强屹立，击退了所有朝家乡进军的精灵，这也给予了周遭的小国拯救的期望。作为我们提供保护的交换，庵都阇萨、乌摩达阇和波楼些般那窣这些前波罗部在所谓的乌摩达阇联盟中成为了都阇揭的附庸。这一事件表明，这数个世纪以来飞升半岛头一回统一在一位强大统治者之下。

在这次统一之后，建立一个单一的、统一的虎人国家的想法，在半岛居民中逐渐流行起来，许多人指出，雄流城的堕落和不团结是诃利秣罗阇衰落的主要原因。许多年轻的官员和思想家开始呼吁建立一个新的国家。这只有一个中央集权政府，与罗阇、波罗部和西那波底的旧制度彻底决裂。这个概念被称为繁罗曷或「丛林天堂」，旨在见证我们的家园被改造得比以前更强大、更纯净，不再被任意分割，而是在东洲的各个民族中占据首要地位。这一原始的民族主义理论成为了16世纪晚期和17世纪都阇揭政府重塑自我的指导思想。这向全世界展现了自己的新形象——繁罗曷。
description.text_en:
When central Rahen descended into chaos following the invasion of the Jadd Empire, Tujgal stood strong in the jungles of the south, rebuffing any elven advance into the homeland and offering hope of salvation to those small powers that dwelled nearby. In exchange for our protection, the former Prabhi of Amtujsaat, Umdaj, and Parus Panasur became vassals of Tujgal in the so-called Union of Umdaj, an event which united the entirety of the Ascension Peninsula under one strong ruler for the first time in centuries.

In the aftermath of this unification, the idea of a single, unified harimari state grew popular among the population of the peninsula, with many pointing to the decadence and disunity of Dhenijansar as the principle reason that the Harimraj fell. Instead of old customs, many young officers and thinkers began calling for a new realm, a complete break with the old system of rajas, prabhi, and senapti, with only one centralized government. This concept, called Vanrahar or "Jungle Paradise", aimed to see our home remade stronger and purer than ever before, no longer divided arbitrarily but instead foremost among the nations of Haless. This proto-nationalistic theory would become the guiding philosophy of Tujgal's government in the late 16th and 17th centuries as the kingdom rebranded itself, to all the world, as Vanrahar.

description.text:
在飞升半岛的雨林深处，生长着许多具有奇妙味道和香味的植物。虽然肉食性的虎人以前从未在小范围内分散种植过这些香料，但16世纪初开始到达罗祆海岸的坎诺商人愿意为生长在飞升半岛的一些稀有调味品支付高昂的价格。

1623年，通过《藏红花条例》，许多小型香料农场被合并为庞大的集中式种植园，在接下来的十年里，罗祆南部生产的珍贵香料数量几乎翻了一番，导致了大量的外国贸易涌入。
description.text_en:
In the deep rainforests of the ascension peninsula grow a multitude of plants with wondrous flavors and scents. While the carnivorous harimari never cultivated these spices in anything more than small decentralized parcels before, the Cannorian traders that began to arrive on the shores of Rahen in the early 1600s were willing to pay exorbitant prices for some of the rare seasonings that grew in the Ascension Peninsula.

By merging many of the smaller spice farms into sprawling centralized plantations with the Saffron Ordinance in 1623, the amount of valuable spices produced in southern Rahen nearly doubled over the following decade, leading to a huge influx of foreign trade.

description.text: 在飞升半岛的大丛林边缘，乌摩达阇历经磨难。部缚乌离奴隶国的起义让乌摩达阇失去了土地、贸易路线、海岸线和荣誉。我们的战士被奴隶压倒，我们的监工骄傲自满，毫无准备。虽然起义整体上是对罗阇国的玷污，但我们的人民、我们的战士相信，他们的统治者死于奴隶之手是对他们的反思。我们决心不再措手不及。
description.text_en: On the fringes of the great jungles of the Ascension Peninsula, Umdaj has endured hardships. The uprising of the slave state of Bhuvauri lost Umdaj their land, their trade routes, their coastline, and their honor. Our warriors were overwhelmed by the slaves, our overseers were complacent and unprepared. While it the uprising as a whole was a stain on the Raj, our people, our warriors believed that the death of their ruler at the hands of the slaves was a reflection on them. We are determined not to be caught off guard again.

description.text:
「那些想要统治的人，必须明白他们统治的是谁，以及他们掌权的原因。罗阇会让我们所有人都相信，我们服役是因为我们生来如此。我们在丛林深处的亲戚认为，这是因为我们强大，而其他人弱小。然而，这两者都不是，而是因为统治者必须做对国家和人民，对所有人民最有利的事。

我的曾祖父被奴隶们杀死，因为他把他们当做奴隶。大多数人都会产生复仇的欲望，想要消灭那些杀害了他们祖先的人，但我不会。他是个傻瓜，把一个人当作一无是处的工具来对待，他们自然会为了保护自己而背叛你。我们有什么不同吗？我们虎人对那些侵犯我们的生活方式，侵犯我们的神圣土地，试图统治我们的人大打出手。我不会重蹈他的覆辙。」——闪牙的贾杜
description.text_en:
“Those who would seek to rule, must understand who they are ruling over and why they hold power. The Raja would have us all believe we serve because we were born to. Our kin deeper in the jungles believe it is because we are strong and others are weak. Yet, it is neither, it is because a ruler must do what is best for the country and its people, all of its people.

My great-grandfather was killed by the slaves because he treated them like chattel. Most would be overcome with a desire for revenge, to destroy those who had slain their sire, but not I. He was a fool, treat someone like they are naught but a tool to be used up and they will naturally turn on you to preserve themselves. Are we so different? We Harimari lash out at those who would intrude on our way of life, on our sacred lands, who would try to rule us. I will not make the same mistakes he did.” - Jadu of the Shining Tooth

description.text:
虽然大多数坐骑都不适合虎人，但大象被证明既聪明又结实，足够他们使用。在与伽缚那阇人的长期交往中，乌摩达阇的驯兽师和法师们培育出了越来越大、越来越耐用的大象，并称它们为「罗阇祉」——大象之王。有人说，他们不仅训练大象，还将它们与象灵绑在一起，也许就像虎人飞升一样。在一场战斗中，一个虎人可能相当于6个人，「罗阇祉」也相当于6个正常体型的大象。

可悲的是，罗阇祉的体型如此巨大，以至于这片土地本身无法支持大量的罗阇祉，因此罗阇祉的使用仅限于乌摩达阇的精锐战士。这些巨兽正面装甲，两侧有十几个虎人战士乘坐的装甲车。当它们冲向敌军阵线时，除了最坚固的防御工事外，其他工事都会被夷为平地。然后，被保护在象轿内的虎人战士就会利用这一点，一跃而出，屠杀剩下的被吓呆的守军。

就像一位将军在他的部队遭遇这种冲锋后所说的那样：「猫显然不喜欢被束缚」
description.text_en:
While most mounts were unsuitable for Harimari, elephants proved both intelligent and sturdy enough for them to utilize. Over a long correspondence with the Ghavaanaji Reeshi, the skilled trainers and mages of Umdaj bred and raised increasingly larger and durable beasts -- calling them Rajathi, King of the Elephants. Some say they train not just elephants, but tie them to elephant spirits as well, perhaps in the way the Harimari themselves ascended. As one Harimari might equal a half dozen men in a fight, so do the Rajathi equal a half dozen of their normal sized kin.

Sadly, the Rajathi are so great in size that the land itself cannot support amounts in any great numbers and thus their use is limited to Umdaj’s elite warriors. These were armored on the front, and sported armor plated carriers housing a dozen or so Harimari warriors on either side of the beasts. When unleashed on the enemy’s lines, they would bulldoze all but the most dug-in defenders. This would then be exploited by the Harimari warriors, protected inside the carriers, who would leap out and savage the remaining stunned defenders.

As one Command General was heard to say after his troops had been on the receiving end of one of these charges, “Cats clearly don’t like being confined.”

description.text:
苏汉大师谈到了每种哲学的优点，并指出没有一种哲学能够单独提供我们所寻求的答案。我们在与其他种族和其他流派的交往中看到了这一点。虽然我们虎人可能自诩为最适合统治的人，但我们在很多方面都有所欠缺。我们的驯象师最早是由北方诸国传授的，他们饲养大象的技术无与伦比。我们的统治者与附近人类波罗部的商人打交道，为我们的土地带来了大量财富和新思想。我们中的强硬派甚至竭力反对这给我们带来的好处。

虽然在罗阇国中并非人人平等，但我们至少听取了苏汉大师的话，看到了利用那些证明自己的人才的好处。波罗部的小女儿已经将他的话铭记于心。
description.text_en:
Guru Suhan spoke of the merits of each philosophy and that none alone carried the answers we sought. We have seen this play out in our interactions with other races as well as other schools. While we Harimari might lord ourselves as the most suited to rule, there are many areas we lack. Our trainers were first taught by the northern states, their skills at raising elephants being peerless. Our ruler’s dealings with traders from nearby human Prabhi have brought a great deal of wealth and new ideas into our lands. Even to the point that the hard-liners amongst us struggle to argue against the benefits it has brought us.

While not all are equal in the Raj, we at least heed the words of Guru Suhan and see merit in utilizing the talents of those who prove themselves. The Prabhi’s young daughter has taken more than a few of his words to heart.

effects.display: 可以招募女性将领：允许

description.text: 人们普遍认为，应该仔细阅读虎人的合同，尤其是细枝末节。不止一个天真的商人发现，由于没有仔细阅读合同条款，他们不仅无意中卖掉了自己的货物，还卖掉了存放货物的建筑。然而，世代统治乌摩达阇的闪牙氏族却赢得了相对诚实的......虎人商人的美誉。据说，与闪牙家族的虎人打交道，就意味着会得到他们讨价还价的东西。
description.text_en: There is a common belief that one should always carefully read Harimari contracts, especially the fine print. More than one naive merchant has found themselves inadvertently having sold not only their wares, but the building they were kept in thanks to a less than thorough read of the terms. However, the Shining Tooth clan who have ruled Umdaj for generations has garnered a reputation as relatively honest dealers… for Harimari. It is said that dealing with any Harimari with the shining grin of their fangs meant that one was going to get exactly what they bargained for.

description.text: 乌摩达阇位于阗婆娑那河的大三角洲上，一直是贸易和思想交流的门户。河上的船只来来往往，满载着来自红口城市场的货物，一路驶向辩论的殿堂。三岛城的丝绸、大三角洲的稀有香料、沙楼宫的新思想和新理念都经过我们的土地，每一次经过都会在我们家门口留下一点。 虽然我们自己也能提供香料和木制品，但大河带给我们的远比源自丛林中的多得多。同时，我们灿烂的笑容也为我们的诚实和公平竞争带来了赞誉。
description.text_en: Located on the Dhenbasana’s great delta, Umdaj has been a gateway for trade and ideas flowing to and from the rest of the continent. River boats come and go laden with goods from the markets of Sarisung, all the way to the halls of debate. Sardipadhin silks, rare spices from the great delta, and new thoughts and ideas from Rayavhashapal all pass through our lands and every passage leaves a little of each on our doorstep. While we ourselves have spices and woodwork to offer, our place on the river has brought us far more than the jungles could. All the while, our shining smiles have brought with them acclaim for our honesty and fair play.

description.text: 在霎钵那战役中，作为繁罗曷联军的一部分，乌摩达阇的冲击象冲入了命令秩序的防线，贾达尔骑兵随后利用这一混乱，冲破了援军的防线。联军得以打破对白垒城的包围。即使是在传奇的贾达尔骑兵之中，罗阇祉的冲锋虽然罕见，但也是一道亮丽的风景线。罗阇祉是如此庞大，以至于每头罗阇祉都能像农夫的犁耕田一样犁出一片战场。据说一位贾达尔骑手对此评论道：「莽苍之躯，终非武极。」
description.text_en: During the battle of Seppadna, as part of the Varanhar coalition, Umdaj shock elephants smashed into the lines of the Command, Jaddari calvary then exploited the disruption and broke the lines of the reinforcements. Allowing for the coalition to break the siege of Khiraspid. Even amongst the legendary Jaddari calvary, the sight of a Rajathi charge, though rare, was a sight to behold. So large were the Rajathi that each plowed a stretch of the battlefield before it like a farmer’s plow tills a field. One Jaddari rider was heard to say, “Size isn’t everything.”

description.text:
「是怎样的槌？怎样的链子？在怎样的熔炉中炼成你的脑筋？是怎样的铁砧？怎样的铁臂，敢于捉着这可怖的凶神？

群星投下了他们的投枪。用它们的眼泪润湿了穹苍，他是否微笑着欣赏他的作品？他创造了你，也创造了羔羊？

老虎！老虎！黑夜的森林中，燃烧着的煌煌的火光，是怎样的神手或天眼，造出了你这样的威武堂堂？」
description.text_en:
'What the hammer? What the chain, In what furnace was thy brain? What the anvil? What dread grasp, Dare its deadly terrors clasp!

When the stars threw down their spears, and water'd heaven with their tears, Did he smile his work to see? Did he who made the Lamb make thee?

Tyger Tyger burning bright, In the forests of the night: What immortal hand or eye, Dare frame thy fearful symmetry?'

description.text: 诃利秣消失后，飞升半岛的土地被交给了虎王的一个孙子，一个骄傲和傲慢的战士，名叫伏影的毗制西捺。虽然多年来祖先的许多直系血统已经消亡，不过一千多年后，伏影王朝的领主们仍然带有祖先的血统，以及随之而来的所有荣耀和尊重。
description.text_en: After the Disappearance of Harimar, the lands of the Ascension Peninsula were given to one of The Tiger King's grandsons, a proud and haughty warrior named Vijaysenar the Crouching Shadow. Though many lines of direct descent to the Progenitor have died out over the years, the lords of the Crouching Shadow dynasty still carry the blood of the progenitor over a thousand years later, and all of the glory and respect that comes with it.

description.text:
在飞升丛林中，有一种古老的制度一直维持到今天，每个虎人领主在达到成年并向西那波底证明自己后，都会得到一小块土地，作为专属狩猎场。

这种分散的制度使丛林在很大程度上没有得到发展，而且权力很不集中，但它的好处是更容易对半岛的茂密丛林进行某种程度的控制，并使这里许多雄心勃勃的年轻虎人领主忙于彼此之间的争吵而不是宣称王位。
description.text_en:
An ancient system that is maintained in the Ascension Jungles to this day, each harimari lord is given a small amount of land to govern as exclusive hunting grounds upon reaching maturity and proving themselves to the Senapti.

This decentralized system has left the jungles largely undeveloped and deeply uncentralized, but it has had the benefit of making it far easier to exert some level of control over the dense jungles of the peninsula and to keep the many ambitious young harimari lords here occupied with squabbles against each other and not the throne.

description.text:
几个世纪以来，飞升半岛的虎人很少关注外部世界，而是专注于内部争吵、部落争斗和个人扩张。虽然丛林使任何外部势力都难以征服他们，但尤伽波罗部的数千个小领地几乎不是一个统一的王国，只有一只强大的手才能成功地将半岛的所有努力指向一个方向，而且绝不会持续太久。

这种行为模式在15世纪中期的混乱中终于开始改变，因为军队的普遍动荡和中央政府的低效震撼了西那波底使其行动。在年轻的王子阿陀罗耆罗的带领下，一批新的大臣们的努力帮助罗婆稽苦罗恢复了活力，并再次将其注意力从丛林中转向外部，在1464年王子登基后，罗婆稽苦罗开始从长期的不作为中振作起来，并在罗祆的政治舞台上展示自己。
description.text_en:
For centuries the harimari of the Ascension Peninsula paid scarce attention to the outside world, instead focused on internal squabbles, tribal feuds, and personal aggrandizement. While the jungles made it difficult for any outside power to conquer them, the thousand petty fiefs of the Oghaprabhi were hardly a unified realm, and only a powerful hand could ever succeed in pointing all of the Peninsula’s efforts in one direction, and never for long.

This pattern of behavior finally began to change during the chaos of the mid 1400s, as the general unrest in the military and ineffectiveness of the central government shook the Senapti to action. Efforts by a new cadre of ministers under the young prince Adaraghir helped revitalize Rabaghekhur and turn its focus outwards from the jungles once again, and following the prince's ascension in 1464 Rabaghekhur began to rouse itself from its long period of inactivity and assert itself on the stage of Raheni politics.

description.text: 1485年岬角城反抗该城的部缚乌离总督，作为对此事的回应，充满热情的新晋西那波底保护该城，驱逐了部缚乌离的占领士兵。西那波底阿陀罗耆罗会见了当地城市的领导人，他们中许多人害怕来自巨港城的报复。并且，阿陀罗耆罗同意在该城市建立一个保护国，只要飞升海岸的议员们愿意用他们的财富来加强罗婆稽苦罗。虽然有很多传言说最初的政变是在阿陀罗耆罗的授意下策动的，但当然没有什么可以确凿证明……
description.text_en: In response to a surprisingly effective revolt in Sardika against the Bhuvaurite governor of the city-state in 1485, the newly energized Senapti came to the city's defense and expelled the occupying soldiers of Bhuvauri. The Senapti Adaraghir met with local city leaders, many of whom were fearful of reprisals from Sramaya, and agreed to establish a protectorate over the city if the councilors of Sardika would lend their wealth to strengthening Rabaghekhur. Whilst there were many rumors that the initial coup was instigated at the behest of Adaraghir, of course nothing could be proven conclusively...

description.text: 在丛林中的许多大树中，柚木树被证明是对国家最有用的一种。柚木树以其坚韧和浮力而闻名，在整个飞升半岛都很常见，提供了可以用来建立必要的海军的丰富资源，以控制海浪和其中的丰富贸易。当诃利秣罗阇衰落时，罗婆稽苦罗开始将目光从北方的雄流城转移到南方——越过珍珠湾的波浪，转移到位于阳洲东岸的前门吉-罗祆城邦。
description.text_en: Of the many great trees of the jungle, teak has proven to be one that is most useful for the nation. Notable for its hardiness and buoyancy, the trees are found commonly throughout the ascension peninsula, providing a wealth of resources that can be put to use building up the requisite navy for controlling the waves and the rich trade that sails upon them. As the Harimraj weakened, Rabaghekhur began to shift its gaze not north to Dhenijansar, but south - across the waves of the Gulf of Pearls, to the former Mengi-Raheni city states resting on the eastern coast of Sarhal.

description.text:
虽然维齐尔之战的混乱年代对罗婆稽苦罗的独立行动能力是一个福音，但它也让投机取巧的外部势力沿着罗阇国的边缘攻击孤立的西那波底和波罗部。1503年，罗阇国处于维齐尔战争的最后阶段，部缚乌离趁机扑向毫无准备的罗婆稽苦罗，烧毁了其在岬角城港口的舰队，再次夺回了这座城市。

在这场灾难之后不久，与部缚乌离政府签订了秘密协议的波罗部都阇揭趁机入侵了波苦罗繁的红树林。这些灾难使对无能的西那波底婆祇罗多的朝廷的支持崩溃了，很快大多数尤伽波罗部都宣布效忠于都阇揭的白虎。

前西那波底和他的忠实支持者逃离了他们的祖先的土地，穿过珍珠湾的波浪来到阳洲，在那里他们被前飞升海岸贸易联盟成员所接收。在这里，被流放的婆祇罗多将他在逃亡期间秘密藏匿的财富投入到吸引效忠者的行动中，建立了一个规模虽小但很有战斗力的佣兵团，并谋划着重返他在罗祆的合法地位。虽然他们永远无法夺回祖先的土地，但在晚年，他的儿子阿陀罗耆罗二世受邀成为了梅雷特加班的国王，伏影家族在远离家乡的土地上成为了国王。
description.text_en:
While the chaotic years of the Wars of the Vizierate were a boon for Rabaghekhur’s ability act independently, it also allowed opportunistic outside powers to attack the isolated Senapti and Prabhi along the fringes of the Raj. In 1503, with the Raj in the final throes of the Vizerate Wars, Bhuvauri took their opportunity to pounce on an unprepared Rabaghekhur, burning its fleet in port at Sardika, and retaking the city once again.

This disaster was followed shortly thereafter by an opportunistic invasion of the mangroves of Pahruavan by the Prabhi of Tujgal, who had signed a secret agreement with the Bhuvauri government. These disasters collapsed support for the court of the ineffectual Senapti Bagherad, and soon the majority of the Oghaprabhi were declaring their allegiance to the White Tiger in Tujgal.

Fleeing from their ancestral lands, the former Senapti and his loyal retainers made their way across the waves of the Pearl Gulf to Sarhal, where they were well received by those cities who were former members of the Trade League of Sardika. Here, the exiled Bagherad would invest the wealth he had secreted away during his flight to attract loyalists, founding a small but effective mercenary company and plotting his return to his rightful place in Rahen. Though they would never retake their ancestral lands, in latter years his son Adaraghir II was invited to become King of Meretgeban, the Crouching Shadow becoming kings in a land far from home.

name.text: 梅雷特加班的流亡王国

player_overview.avoid_if: 希望任务路线承认不同族群平等地位或偏爱轻松贸易种田的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先以虎人前身统一飞升半岛并攒军队传统，再形成R77扩张，后期整合种姓、军队与文化。
player_overview.overview: 繁罗曷是原初虎人国家满足领土与军政条件后形成的国度，不是1444年现成强国。你会从飞升半岛出发，换上R77任务树，用军队与传统重塑旧哈里玛王国；后期学院与训练制度伴随严苛种姓和对人类的制度性劳役。这是一条强力但阴暗的复国路线。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢军事化形成国、虎人旧帝国和高强度罗祆战役的玩家。
signature_features: 不同虎人前身可接入同一形成国，拥有各自衔接任务。
形成门槛与地区战争决定前中期节奏。
人类劳役、种姓和文化转化是后期国家形态的核心代价。
player_overview.tagline: 统一虎人故土，建立军事化的丛林天堂，并决定谁有资格成为国家的主人。

reasons: 虎人古国复兴故事鲜明
多个前身形成路线可改变开局体验
军事强国与内部制度相互牵连
warnings: 后期族群政策明显压迫人类

positive_indicators: 建设军事训练与战士居住设施
设立繁罗曷学院传承知识
整合飞升半岛的行政与生产
values.rationale: 任务后段明确要求刚性种姓与低人类容忍，剧情把人类设为服务上层的低种姓，脚本给人类文化省份永久的文化转化激励；学院和军事建设有公共收益。低分源于具体制度性压迫，而非虎人身份、战争或君主制。
red_flags: 人类及其他群体被规定为服务上层的低种姓
刚性种姓与低人类容忍是关键任务条件
人类文化省份被持续推动转化并带来国家资源
